articles.title: 並列 Claude Code セッションは何回ぶつかったか：2週間のログを hook に再生して数えた
articles.accessNote: Full public original article body. Measurements are author-reported. No source code or commands executed.
articles.facts: Author replayed about 100,000 shell commands in 7.0 GB of personal Mac logs over two weeks in 39 seconds. 507 would have been blocked; 25 git add -A in trees another session edited. Port and memory guards were not replayed. Command-level hook is not sandbox isolation.
